 HONOR Play 20A arrives on Shopee this 11.11 for as low as PHP 45 a day
 Get HONOR’s newest smartphone for PHP 8,099, with exclusive Shopee vouchers, free shipping, and 0% interest installments via SPayLater. 
 INQUIRER.net / 07:11 PM November 05, 2026 
 Share: 
 Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines is giving Filipino consumers an early opportunity to get the HONOR Play 20A, exclusively on Shopee this November 11 as part of the 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale. With a special selling price of PHP 8,099, down from its PHP 8,999 SRP, customers can also get the smartphone for as low as PHP 45 per day for six months with 0% interest via SPayLater.
 Designed for everyday convenience and entertainment, the HONOR Play 20A features an interactive 2-inch Smart Rear Screen that lets users check notifications, control media, and take selfies using the rear camera. It also comes with a 6.9-inch display with a 90Hz refresh rate for smoother viewing and a 6,000mAh battery to support everyday use.
 “We want to make the HONOR Play 20A more accessible to Filipino consumers while giving them more ways to enjoy its features,” said Stephen Cheng, Vice President of HONOR Philippines. “Through our exclusive Shopee availability this 11.11, customers can take advantage of special pricing, vouchers, and flexible payment options, making it easier to experience a smartphone designed for their everyday needs.”
 Get More Deals This 11.11 on Shopee 
 Customers can enjoy the HONOR Play 20A at PHP 8,099, with an additional 20% OFF Mega Discount Voucher and free shipping available on Shopee. Those who prefer installment payments can also get the device for as low as PHP 45 per day for six months at 0% interest through SPayLater.
 Shoppers can also look forward to exclusive discounts, vouchers, and freebies during Shopee Live sessions featuring James Afante on November 10 at 12 noon and Kris Aquino and Bimby Aquino on November 10 at 6 PM. 
 The HONOR Play 20A will be available exclusively on Shopee for early online access on November 11, ahead of its official launch and nationwide availability on November 28, 2026.
 For more information about HONOR Philippines, you may visit: https://www.honor.com/ph/ . To stay updated on launch announcements, product information, and exclusive offers, follow HONOR Philippines’ social media platforms on Facebook , Instagram , and TikTok for exclusive launch updates, product information, and more. #HONORPlay20A #HONORPhilippines
 ADVT.
